title: Risk & Capital Management Rules
rule_1: Strict 1% max capital risk per trade based on entry-to-stop distance
rule_2: Max 4 simultaneous open positions and 12% max capital exposure
rule_3: At 8% Drawdown: Halve new position size (0.5% risk per trade)
rule_4: At 12% Drawdown: Halt all new trade entries (Circuit Breaker)
rule_5: At RR=1.5: Move Stop Loss to Breakeven & activate Trailing Stop (1.2×ATR)
rule_6: At RR=2.5: Secure profit by closing 50% & trail remaining 50%
